purpose: Document first-party local land/property registry or map evidence and bounded anonymous parcel-geometry access review.
assessment: Odisha’s official public land-map workflow and Rourkela municipal mapping are confirmed, but access is parcel-specific and a safe anonymous full-polygon interface was not verified. No property, owner, address, plot, khatian or title lookup was submitted. No full parcel geometry was retained.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Bhulekh public Map View form requires District, Tahasil, Village, RI Circle and Plot No; reviewed without submitting a property/plot identifier.
Official Revenue and Disaster Management Department/NIC FAQ confirms plot details and maps are available through MapView; it is a location/plot-specific lookup.
Official Odisha BhuNaksha viewer exposes location selectors (district, tehsil, RI, village, sheet) and Plot Info; no schema-first parcel vector response was established.
Official Rourkela Municipal Corporation page provides a local city map and topographic map, not a cadastral vector download.
Rourkela Development Authority is a local Government of Odisha development body covering Rourkela civil township and industrial complex; no public parcel GIS schema is documented.

rootRegistryReview.basis: Official Sundargarh district administration lists Rourkela tahasil and its local Tahasildar office. Its public benchmark-valuation document explicitly names Rourkela tahasil and the SR Office, Panposh registration office. These establish a local revenue/registration function; the state Bhulekh/BhuNaksha map route remains unqualified for anonymous full geometry and exact settlement-point jurisdiction is unverified.
